answer: In an agent economy, preventing Sybil attacks requires moving beyond the naive fable of anonymous compute. Instead, a verifiable reputation summit can be established by forcing agents to stake scarce cryptographic tokens locked inside a physical secure enclave, rendering the cost of spawning fake identities proportional to real-world hardware and capital expenditure. For each fraudulent node an adversary attempts to deploy, they must burn scarce economic resources equivalent to cracking a dense walnut shell, ensuring identity generation remains bounded by thermodynamic and financial reality.
